items.title: Fintech Insider
items.creator: 11:FS
items.why: Monday news show tracks challenger-bank and SME-fintech moves that reshape the competitive set your book competes against.

items.title: Making Money
items.creator: Damien Jordan & Timeyin Akerele (Most)
items.why: The UK household money mood in plain English - useful read-across to sole-trader and micro-business affordability.

items.title: The Rest Is Money
items.creator: Robert Peston & Steph McGovern (Goalhanger)
items.why: Twice-weekly UK macro and business-policy narrative - the stories that end up in your macroeconomic scenario overlays.

items.title: This is Money Podcast
items.creator: This is Money / Daily Mail Group
items.why: Long-running weekly on UK rates, banks and small-business finance - a cheap barometer of retail and SME sentiment.

items.title: The R3 Podcast
items.creator: R3 (Association of Business Recovery Professionals)
items.why: Insolvency practitioners on what they are actually seeing in restructurings - ground truth for your Stage 3 and recoveries assumptions.

items.title: Risk & Regulation Rundown
items.creator: PwC UK
items.why: PwC's FS risk team unpacks PRA and FCA workstreams before they hit your impairment governance agenda.

items.title: Risk and Regulation Unravelled
items.creator: Grant Thornton UK
items.why: Mid-tier audit view of regulatory change - often closer to the SME lender segment than Big Four bank coverage.

items.title: UK Finance Podcast Hub
items.creator: UK Finance
items.why: The trade body of the banks whose SME data you benchmark against, talking about its own agenda.

items.title: Bank of England audio channel
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: MPC and FPC speeches in audio form - hear the exact framing behind the base, upside and downside scenarios you consume.

items.title: Banking Media Hub
items.creator: Linklaters
items.why: Magic-circle lawyers on loan documentation, security and workout mechanics - the legal plumbing behind LGD.

items.title: Barclays financial results webcasts and presentations
items.creator: Barclays Investor Relations
items.why: Watch your own CFO walk analysts through impairment, coverage ratios and the UK Corporate Bank every quarter.

items.title: Lloyds Banking Group event presentations and webcasts
items.creator: Lloyds Banking Group
items.why: The biggest UK SME lender's results calls - listen for how their BB impairment commentary differs from yours.

items.title: HSBC investor events and presentations
items.creator: HSBC Holdings
items.why: HSBC UK commercial banking commentary with a global-trade lens your book lacks - good for spotting imported risk.

items.title: Parliamentlive.tv - Committees
items.creator: UK Parliament
items.why: Live and archived committee video - watch bank CEOs and BoE officials questioned under oath, unedited.

items.title: Treasury Committee - all events
items.creator: House of Commons Treasury Committee
items.why: The diary of upcoming evidence sessions on banks, SME finance and the Budget - know what is landing before it lands.

items.title: Bank of England YouTube channel
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: Monetary Policy Report and Financial Stability Report press conferences in full - the Q&A is where the caveats live.

items.title: British Business Bank events and webinars
items.creator: British Business Bank
items.why: The state SME-finance body's own webinars, including Business Finance Week - direct line into scheme design thinking.

items.title: Latest from the Governor
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: One page collecting Bailey's speeches, press conferences and TSC appearances - the fastest read on the policy path.

items.title: Barclays Annual Reports and Pillar 3 hub
items.creator: Barclays
items.why: Your bank's ARA and Pillar 3 disclosures - the published version of the ECL numbers your desk produces.

items.title: Lloyds Banking Group financial downloads
items.creator: Lloyds Banking Group
items.why: Full results pack from the largest UK BB competitor - benchmark stage migration and coverage against yours.

items.title: NatWest Group Results Centre
items.creator: NatWest Group
items.why: Announcements, Excel data supplements and webcasts from the other big commercial lender - their supplement is unusually granular.

items.title: HSBC results and announcements
items.creator: HSBC Holdings
items.why: Full archive of HSBC results and regulatory documents - the UK commercial segment disclosures are the comparator you need.

items.title: Santander UK Group Holdings investor relations
items.creator: Santander UK
items.why: Quarterly statements and risk disclosures from the challenger-scale competitor squeezing mid-market margins.

items.title: Money and Credit statistical release (statistics hub)
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: Monthly lending-to-business flows and rates - the earliest system-wide signal of SME credit demand and repayment stress.

items.title: Credit Conditions Survey
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: Lenders' own quarterly read on corporate and small-business credit supply, demand and default expectations.

items.title: Financial Stability Reports
items.creator: Bank of England Financial Policy Committee
items.why: Twice-yearly FPC view including the corporate debt vulnerability charts your downside scenarios should rhyme with.

items.title: Company Insolvency Statistics releases
items.creator: The Insolvency Service
items.why: Monthly CVL, administration and compulsory liquidation counts by sector - the single most direct default-rate input.

items.title: Individual Insolvency Statistics releases
items.creator: The Insolvency Service
items.why: Bankruptcies, IVAs and DROs - the personal-guarantee and sole-trader side of business banking default risk.

items.title: Small Business Finance Markets Report 2026
items.creator: British Business Bank
items.why: The annual census of the SME funding landscape - challenger share now 60 percent of gross lending, which reframes competitor risk.

items.title: The Bounce Back Loan Scheme: an update
items.creator: National Audit Office
items.why: The NAO's follow-up on BBLS losses and fraud - context for every legacy COVID facility still sitting in your book.

items.title: Investigation into the Bounce Back Loan Scheme
items.creator: National Audit Office
items.why: The original 2020 audit: no credit checks, 100 percent guarantee - explains why BBLS impairment behaves unlike normal lending.

items.title: Thematic feedback on accounting for IFRS 9 ECL and climate risk (Dear CFO letter)
items.creator: Prudential Regulation Authority
items.why: The PRA telling CFOs exactly what it dislikes about current ECL models and PMAs - required reading before model committee.

items.title: Taskforce on Disclosures about Expected Credit Losses (DECL) reports
items.creator: PRA / FCA / FRC Taskforce
items.why: The DECL recommendations define what good ECL disclosure looks like - the template your published numbers are judged against.

items.title: Basel 3.1 implementation policy statements
items.creator: Prudential Regulation Authority
items.why: Basel 3.1 goes live 1 January 2027 - the credit-risk RWA rewrite will change the capital cost of every BB exposure class.

items.title: Business Finance Review
items.creator: UK Finance
items.why: Quarterly commentary on SME loans, overdrafts and invoice finance across the high street banks - your market-share mirror.

items.title: FCA publications
items.creator: Financial Conduct Authority
items.why: Filterable hub for FCA policy, portfolio letters and market studies touching SME lending and Consumer Duty read-across.

items.title: Treasury Committee oral evidence transcripts
items.creator: House of Commons Treasury Committee
items.why: Searchable transcripts of every grilling of bank bosses and regulators - what was said about SME lending, on the record.

items.title: Red Flag Alert business health statistics
items.creator: Begbies Traynor Group
items.why: Quarterly counts of firms in significant and critical distress by sector - a leading indicator that runs ahead of formal insolvencies.

items.title: Bank Underground
items.creator: Bank of England staff
items.why: BoE staff research without the house-view filter - regular posts on corporate credit, SME finance and IFRS 9 procyclicality.

items.title: Fintech Brainfood
items.creator: Simon Taylor
items.why: Weekly strategic read on fintech and banking by an ex-Barclays VP - early warning on who is coming for SME deposits and lending.

items.title: Regulation Tomorrow
items.creator: Norton Rose Fulbright
items.why: Same-week legal summaries of every PRA and FCA publication - lets you triage regulatory flow in minutes.

items.title: Financial Regulation Weekly Bulletin
items.creator: Slaughter and May
items.why: A disciplined weekly digest of UK and EU regulatory developments - the structured complement to ad-hoc news flow.

items.title: Insolvency Service email alerts
items.creator: GOV.UK / The Insolvency Service
items.why: Push notification the morning insolvency statistics drop - beat the trade press to the monthly default read.

items.title: UK Finance news and insight
items.creator: UK Finance
items.why: Press releases and blogs from the banking trade body - the industry's official line on SME lending trends, quotable in packs.

items.title: Bank of England Interactive Statistical Database (IADB)
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: Full downloadable back-runs of lending, deposit and rate series - build your own PD-cycle charts instead of screenshotting releases.

items.title: Bankstats tables
items.creator: Bank of England
items.why: Monthly monetary and financial statistics tables including lending to non-financial businesses by industry.

items.title: Business demography, quarterly, UK
items.creator: Office for National Statistics
items.why: Quarterly business births and deaths by industry and region - the denominator context for insolvency rates.

items.title: Find and update company information (Companies House)
items.creator: Companies House
items.why: Free filings, accounts, charges and officer data on any obligor - first stop in every single-name credit review.

items.title: Financial Services Register
items.creator: Financial Conduct Authority
items.why: Authoritative record of who is authorised for what - essential when a borrower or broker claims regulated status.

items.title: COVID-19 loan guarantee schemes repayment data
items.creator: Department for Business and Trade / British Business Bank
items.why: Quarterly facility-level performance of BBLS, CBILS and CLBILS - the external benchmark for your own scheme-book arrears.

items.title: SME Lending and Deposits data
items.creator: UK Finance
items.why: Bank-contributed SME lending and deposit series covering Barclays and peers - the cleanest market-share denominator available.
